mobbin:d9108d06-2686-4dcb-b1da-6847d7e5a.summary: In Halide’s viewfinder the user switches discrete focal-length stops from 1x to 2x; no pan, tilt, or continuous zoom control appears.
steal: Pill of labeled stops (.5, 1x, 2) instead of a continuous zoom slider (step 1x selected).
Active stop highlighted (yellow fill) so current magnification is obvious (step 2x selected).
avoid: Do not treat as full PTZ — screens show only discrete zoom; no pan, tilt, presets, or click-to-point.
mobbin:d9108d06-2686-4dcb-b1da-6847d7e5a.fit: Informs simplified zoom outside/beside SRV live view (discrete stops for faculty); does not replace a 360 dewarp or PTZ joystick — honest zoom-only model.
